jobs.occupation: Erfaren kok søges til burgerrestaurant
jobs.description:
Kok søges til burgerrestaurant i vækst i indre København

Er du en erfaren kok, der trives i et travlt køkken og går op i kvalitet, struktur og godt samarbejde? Så er det måske dig, vi søger til vores burgerrestaurant i København

Hos CPH Smash i Kødbyen er vi i vækst og søger en erfaren kok, som kan blive en del af vores køkkenteam og være med til at sikre, at vores mad altid lever op til vores standarder.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du har tidligere erfaring fra et professionelt køkken, og at du kan arbejde selvstændigt såvel som sammen med resten af teamet.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Som kok hos os vil dine primære arbejdsopgaver være:

• 
Tilberedning af vores burgere og øvrige retter

• 
Forberedelse af råvarer og mise en place

• 
Sikre ensartet kvalitet og korrekt tilberedning

• 
Arbejde effektivt under travle serviceperioder

• 
Overholde gældende krav til hygiejne, rengøring og fødevaresikkerhed

• 
Bidrage til en god struktur og arbejdsgang i køkkenet

• 
Samarbejde med resten af køkkenteamet om den daglige drift

Derudover vil der være mulighed for et særligt ansvar for vores fastfood-relaterede køkken- og tilberedningsmaskiner.

Det er derfor en klar fordel, hvis du har erfaring med forskellige typer professionelle køkkenmaskiner og tilberedningsudstyr, både service og vedligeholdelse, eller generelt har teknisk forståelse og interesse for at sætte dig ind i udstyret. Det er ikke et krav, at du har arbejdet med præcis de samme maskiner tidligere – det vigtigste er, at du er praktisk anlagt og har lyst til at tage ansvar for området.

Vi forventer, at du

• 
Har relevant erfaring som kok fra et professionelt køkken

• 
Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver

• 
Trives med et højt arbejdstempo

• 
Kan bevare overblikket, når der er travlt

• 
Er kvalitetsbevidst og har sans for detaljer

• 
Er mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst

• 
Kan samarbejde godt med kolleger

• 
Har en positiv og professionel tilgang til arbejdet

Tidligere køkkenerfaring er et krav. Vi søger en person, der allerede har erfaring fra et professionelt køkken og er komfortabel med at arbejde i et miljø, hvor tempo og kvalitet går hånd i hånd.

Vi tilbyder

• 
En fast rolle i en burgerrestaurant i vækst

• 
Et travlt og dynamisk køkken

• 
Gode kolleger og en uformel omgangstone

• 
Mulighed for at få ansvar for et specifikt område af køkkendriften

• 
Mulighed for at udvikle dig sammen med virksomheden

• 
Løn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så hører vi gerne fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og CV info@cphsmash.dk

Du er også velkommen til at kontakte os på +45 30113154, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning allerede i dag.

 Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og byde den rette kandidat velkommen på holdet!

ENGLISH VERSION:
Experienced Chef Wanted for Growing Burger Restaurant in Central Copenhagen

Are you an experienced chef who thrives in a busy kitchen and takes pride in quality, structure, and good teamwork? Then you may be the person we are looking for to join our burger restaurant in Copenhagen.

At CPH Smash in Kødbyen, we are growing and are looking for an experienced chef to join our kitchen team and help ensure that our food consistently meets our standards.

We value candidates who have previous experience working in a professional kitchen and who are comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.

Your Responsibilities

As a chef with us, your primary responsibilities will include:

• 
Preparing our burgers and other menu items

• 
Preparing ingredients and mise en place

• 
Ensuring consistent quality and correct preparation

• 
Working efficiently during busy service periods

• 
Maintaining high standards of hygiene, cleaning, and food safety

• 
Contributing to good structure and efficient workflows in the kitchen

• 
Working closely with the rest of the kitchen team in the daily operation

In addition, there will be an opportunity to take specific responsibility for our fast-food-related kitchen and cooking equipment.

It is therefore a huge advantage if you have experience with different types of professional kitchen equipment and cooking machinery, including servicing and maintenance, or if you generally have a technical understanding and an interest in learning how the equipment works.

You do not need to have worked with exactly the same equipment before – what matters most is that you are practical, willing to learn, and interested in taking responsibility for this area.

We Expect You To

• 
Have relevant experience as a chef in a professional kitchen

• 
Be able to work independently and take responsibility for your tasks

• 
Thrive in a fast-paced environment

• 
Be able to maintain an overview during busy periods

• 
Be quality-conscious and have an eye for detail

• 
Be reliable and responsible

• 
Work well with colleagues

• 
Have a positive and professional approach to your work

Previous professional kitchen experience is a requirement. We are looking for someone who already has experience from a professional kitchen and is comfortable working in an environment where speed and quality go hand in hand.

We Offer

• 
A permanent position in a growing burger restaurant

• 
A busy and dynamic kitchen environment

• 
Great colleagues and an informal workplace culture

• 
The opportunity to take responsibility for a specific area of the kitchen operation

• 
Opportunities to develop alongside the company

• 
Salary based on qualifications and experience

Does This Sound Like You?

Then we would love to hear from you.

Send your application and CV to info@cphsmash.dk.

You are also welcome to contact us on +45 30 11 31 54 if you have any questions about the position.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so feel free to send your application today.

 We look forward to hearing from you and welcoming the right candidate to the team!

Opgaver

• 
Plukke varer fra lageret 

• 
Opfyldning

• 
Varemodtagelse

• 
Andre ad. hoc lageropgaver

jobs.occupation: Restaurant Manager – Music-Themed Dining Experience

jobs.occupation: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
jobs.description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

jobs.occupation: Køkken souschef søges til burger restaurant i vækst
jobs.description:

• 
At sikre høj kvalitet og ensartethed i vores mad

•

• 
At sikre, at hygiejne, rengøring og egenkontrol er i orden

• 
At tage ansvar for køkkenet, når køkkenchefen ikke er til stede

At bidrage med idéer til udvikling af menu, arbejdsgange og køkkendrift

Vi forventer, at du

• 
Har erfaring fra et professionelt køkken – gerne som souschef, kok eller lignende

• 
Trives med højt tempo og mange bestillinger

• 
Kan bevare overblikket, når der er travlt

• 
Er kvalitetsbevidst og går op i detaljerne

• 
Er en naturlig leder, som kan skabe respekt og god energi omkring dig

Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og fleksibel

• 
Har lyst til at være en del af en virksomhed i vækst

jobs.occupation: Plumber / Plumbing Installer - Plumbing & Heating - Lolland, Denmark
jobs.description:
Bang's VVS is looking for one qualified and experienced plumber / plumbing installer to join our team on Lolland, Denmark.

You'll need to already have the legal right to work in Denmark, for example EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship, or a valid Danish work and residence permit. Unfortunately, we're not able to offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this role.

Your role

You will carry out varied plumbing work for private customers, businesses, industry and construction projects on Lolland.

We are looking for someone who:

Is a qualified plumber with relevant vocational training
Has practical experience as a plumber
Can work independently and deliver high-quality work
Is service-minded and comfortable working with customers
Can communicate in English
Has a category B driving licence
Is willing to relocate to Lolland and make the area your place of residence

What we offer

Gross hourly wage: DKK 180-220, depending on qualifications and experience
Candidates with several years of relevant experience can expect a salary at the higher end of the range
Permanent employment, 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday
Pension scheme
5 weeks of vacation
Flexible benefits account for extra vacation, salary or pension
Company vehicle
Assistance with finding suitable accommodation

About Bang's VVS

Bang's VVS is an authorised Danish plumbing and sheet metal company established in 2016.

The company works with private customers, businesses, industry, agriculture and construction projects and handles both small and large projects. Bang's VVS places strong emphasis on quality workmanship, good customer service and energy-efficient solutions.

You will join an informal workplace with good colleagues, a high degree of independence and a strong focus on quality workmanship.

Recruitment Process

The first interview can be conducted online if required. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the workplace before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

How to apply

Send your application to:

rekruttering@lolland.dk

Please write "Bang's VVS" in the subject line.

If you have questions about the position, please contact:

Martin Hansen
Business Consultant and EURES adviser, Lolland Municipality
Phone: +45 21 47 73 43
Email: maha@lolland.dk

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and Relocation Support

Lolland is located in the southern part of Denmark, offering a peaceful lifestyle with easy access to nature, beaches, and open countryside. The region combines affordable housing, short commuting distances, and a strong sense of community.

The region is currently experiencing significant development, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link, one of Europe's largest infrastructure projects, which will create a direct road and rail connection between Denmark and Germany.

As an international employee, you will have access to Lolland Municipality's Newcomers Service, which offers free support with relocation, registration, housing guidance, partner job support, and settling into life in Denmark.

For more information about Lolland and contact details, visit https://newcomers.lolland.dk/

More information about living and working in Denmark can be found at www.workindenmark.dk

jobs.occupation: True Dates Production Operator
jobs.description:
True Co. was founded in 2017 and began as an entrepreneurial journey in the founders’ kitchen, where they experimented with developing plastic-free chewing gum. The idea of revolutionizing snacking through more natural alternatives has since developed into a company that today also produces True Dates. The products are sold in more than 50 countries and the company is growing. True Co. is therefore looking for operators for newly established shifts at the True Dates factory in Glostrup at Formervangen 13. Working hours will be 21.55 to 07.10 Monday to Thursday

Your primary tasks

• 
Physical production, operation, and monitoring of production and processing equipment.

• 
Rotation between stations and different parts of the process is a natural part of the work.

• 
Ongoing checks, measurements, and record-keeping in accordance with documented standards.

• 
Troubleshooting and problem-solving in collaboration with the maintenance team.

• 
Cleaning and preparation of equipment and the production area.

• 
Ensuring quality and food safety.

• 
Ad hoc tasks related to production, warehouse, and cleaning depending on needs.

Qualifications

• 
You enjoy working in a dynamic work environment with clear production targets and requirements for tasty products, while actively contributing to maintaining high food safety standards.

• 
You like working in teams where colleagues help each other to complete tasks.

• 
Not a requirement but a plus if you have experience as a process operator, industrial operator, process technologist, or similar. Experience from food production or another regulated environment is an advantage.

• 
You have a mechanical/technical interest.

• 
You can read and understand English, as documentation, instructions, and the corporate language is English.

The work is carried out under controlled conditions, and therefore requirements apply regarding personal hygiene and mandatory clothing provided by the company.

We offer

• 
Thorough training in operating machines.

• 
Training in producing food according to GMP standards.

• 
Competitive salary

jobs.occupation: Associate Professor in ’Oxide semiconductors for photovoltaic applications’
jobs.description:
The Mads Clausen Institute, Center for Advanced Photovoltaics and Thin-Film Energy Devices (SDU CAPE) invites applications for a tenured Associate Professor position in ‘Oxide semiconductors for photovoltaic applications’. The starting date is Nov. 1st, 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

What we offer
The Associate Professor position is a part of the SDU CAPE research center, which aims to develop new sustainable photovoltaics and energy technologies using scalable and green processing techniques. This includes activities bridging from synthesis of oxide semiconductors and thin films to their integrate in complete photovoltaic devices, to push the limits of new flexible thin film photovoltaics for the green energy transition. We offer an Associate Professor position within a dynamic research environment that includes students, researchers and research engineers. The position includes both research and teaching responsibilities.

What we expect

Candidates who have a previous PhD degree in a field relevant to the mentioned area may seek the position (physics, chemistry, material science, electrical engineering and similar). You must have a proven strong track record of publications within the areas of e.g. synthesis of oxide semiconductors and thin films, structure-property relationships, PVD processes for oxide thin film fabrication and scale-up, oxide thin films for photovoltaics applications e.g. as transparent conductive oxides, transport layers, active layers, light management layers or barrier layers. The candidate must have documented teaching experience (Assistant Prof. level). The ideal candidate has also documented supervision experience and demonstrated the ability to attract external research funding. Due to the interdisciplinary nature of the work, the candidates are expected to have excellent collaboration skills. A very good capability of communicating scientific results in English, both orally and in writing is required.

The Associate Professor is thus expected to: 

• 
Collaborate with other team members at SDU CAPE and supervise younger researchers

• 
Take responsibility for and lead new research directions within the overall area of oxide semiconductors for photovoltaic applications

• 
Contribute to establishing new innovation based activities within oxide semiconductors for photovoltaic applications

• 
Be responsible for teaching courses at SDU and supervise BSc, MSc and PhD students

• 
Contribute to obtaining funding for research and innovation projects

• 
Contribute to establishing and maintaining international collaborations

Workplace description / Research environment
We are an international research center working in the field of green energy technologies (CAPE), and we are looking for a highly motivated Associate Professor to join our CAPE research center at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), campus Sønderborg. We offer a modern, inclusive, international and interdisciplinary working environment with state-of-the-art facilities as well as a strong tradition of international collaboration. Our ambition is, to recruit, develop, and retain talented scholars committed to both academic excellence and departmental development.

Having a focus on thin film technologies for energy conversion and storage, the center has full access to a surface science laboratory facility for the fabrication and characterization of thin films and photovoltaic devices, as well as a fully equipped Roll-to-Roll (R2R) facility for upscaling flexible devices. Our research center CAPE is a partner in various national and international research projects and networks that include collaboration partners from both academia and industry. SDU CAPE is also leading the new SDU Climate Cluster (SCC) Elite Center SOLEN, which span across four faculties at SDU to foster, in a cross-disciplinary manner, new thin film solar energy conversion and storage technologies based on green and sustainable solutions.

Read more and apply on: http://www.sdu.dk/en/stillinger
